name: High-Density FIFO Gravity Racks for Auto-Component Storage
challenge: An automotive assembly plant faced severe floor congestion and parts-mixing due to lack of structured inventory rotation. Operators spent critical time searching for correct part batches.
solution: We designed and installed a series of heavy-duty, 3-tier gravity FIFO (First-In-First-Out) flow racks using 28mm ABS coated steel pipes, metal sockets, and 40-series polypropylene roller tracks.
result: Established 100% parts rotation tracking, reduced operators' picking search times by 40%, and increased shopfloor space utilization by 25%.

name: ESD Workstation Assembly Line for Electronics Manufacturer
challenge: An electronics manufacturing facility experienced 4% component failures due to electrostatic discharge (ESD) during manual soldering, alongside operator fatigue from non-ergonomic desks.
solution: We engineered custom height-adjustable workstations on 40x40 aluminium profiles, fitted with ESD conductive laminate tops, static-dissipative wrist strap sockets, and overhead tool holders.
result: ESD component failure rates dropped to 0.1%, and operator productivity improved by 18% due to ergonomic accessory layouts.

name: Robotic Welding Cell Perimeter Safety Guarding System
challenge: A metal fabrication plant required immediate compliance with ISO safety standards for high-speed robotic welding cells. Existing steel fencing took days to weld and install.
solution: We supplied and installed a modular safety fencing system using 40-series aluminium profiles with a safety yellow coating, paired with clear polycarbonate panes and wire mesh panels.
result: Completed the 50-meter perimeter fence installation in under 8 hours with zero welding required, fully achieving ISO safety compliance.
